dedupe_keys.name: archetype based life cycle assessment of national residential building stocks resource use and greenhouse gas emissions in western asia and northern africa

description: This release provides residential building-stock archetype inputs for countries in Western Asia and North Africa. Zenodo lists 38 public Excel workbooks and a text README under CC BY 4.0. Country sheets contain literature references, semantic, geometric and technical archetype parameters, stock information and, for some countries, schedules; additional workbooks provide vacancy rates and resource-use results. The parameters can define national building-stock mixes for energy and material-use scenarios or allow sensitivity checks across archetypes. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this multi-country sheet collection. A limitation is that the public README says the associated DesignBuilder or IDF energy models are available only on request, so this draft covers the published input sheets, not an open executable model suite. Country coverage and evidence quality vary with the literature assembled by the authors. The individual workbook formulas, units and simulation outputs were not checked. No spreadsheet or model was downloaded.
